blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Glioblastoma exhibits substantial heterogeneity in tumour morphology and composition across MRI modalities, often making available clinical datasets highly unbalanced in terms of patient pathologies. We propose a two-stage latent diffusion model (LDM) framework for the generation of explicitly controllable 2D glioblastoma MRI scans. First, a segmentation LDM generates tumour maps conditioned on location, spatial extent, axial position, and subregion composition. Second, a modality-conditioned LDM with ControlNet generates T1, T1Gd, T2, and FLAIR images adhering to the requested segmentation. On a held-out test set, generated segmentations achieved a mean centroid error of 0.842 pixels and a subregion proportion error of 0.795 percentage points. ControlNet improved Fréchet inception distance (FID) across all four modalities, reducing pooled FID from 42.59 to 36.12. An expert reader study yielded mean quality ratings of 6.60 for real images, 6.83 for ControlNet-generated images, and 6.77 for fully synthetic images.
blocks.zh: 细胞瘤在肿瘤形态学和各种核磁共振模式的构成中表现出显著的异质性,往往使临床数据集在患者病理方面极不平衡。 我们提出一个两阶段潜在扩散模型(LDM)框架,用于生成可明确控制的2D glioblastoma磁共振扫描. 首先,分块LDM生成以位置、空间范围、轴位置和次区域构成为条件的肿瘤图。 第二,一个带有ControlNet的有模式条件的LDM生成T1,T1Gd,T2,以及FLAIR图像,坚持要求的分区. 在被搁置的测试集中,生成的片段实现了0.842像素的平均百分数误差和0.795个百分点的次区域比例误差. ControlNet改进了Fréchet在所有四种模式中的启动距离(FID),将集合的FID从42.59减少到36.12。 专家读者研究得出的平均质量评级为:真实图像6.60,控制网生成的图像6.83,全面合成图像6.77。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Glioblastoma is an aggressive form of brain cancer with a high degree of heterogeneity across T1, T1Gd, T2 and FLAIR MRI. The diversity observed in finite clinical glioblastoma datasets is only partially representative of the true variability of real-world patients, limiting the robustness of data-driven models. Recent advances in diffusion models have demonstrated that generative models are able to produce high-fidelity images while capturing useful variation [ 6 ] , [ 4 ] . However, unconditional generation alone cannot deliberately oversample rare tumour locations, sizes, or subregion compositions.
blocks.zh: Glioblastoma是脑癌的一种侵略性形式,跨越T1,T1Gd,T2和FLAIR核磁共振的异性很强. 在有限的临床胶囊瘤数据集中观察到的多样性只是部分地代表了现实世界患者的真实可变性,限制了数据驱动模型的稳健性. 最近在传播模型方面的进步表明,基因模型能够产生高真实度图像,同时捕获有用的变异[6],[4]. 然而,单是无条件的生成,不能故意对稀有肿瘤的位置、大小或次区域成分进行过度抽样。

blocks.en: We address this with a two-stage framework that separates pathology generation from MRI synthesis. Our main contributions are: (i) a conditional generative model (Seg-LDM) for explicit spatial and compositional control of synthetic tumour segmentation maps; (ii) a two-stage generative framework that propagates a requested pathology into the synthesis of multi-modal brain MRI scans; (iii) quantitative evaluation of condition adherence and image fidelity, complemented by an expert reader study.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个将病理生成与核磁共振合成分开的两阶段框架来解决这个问题。 我们的主要贡献是:(一) 有条件的基因模型(Seg-LDM),用于对合成肿瘤分解图进行明确的空间和组成控制;(二) 将所要求的病理传播到多模式大脑核磁共振扫描合成的两阶段基因框架;(三) 对条件坚持性和图像忠诚性进行定量评价,辅之以专家读者研究。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Denoising diffusion models [ 6 ] have emerged as a powerful generative modelling approach. In medical imaging, Pinaya et al. [ 12 ] demonstrated that latent diffusion models (LDMs) are capable of generating high-resolution 3D brain MRI scans, while Khader et al. [ 9 ] demonstrated the utility of synthetic biomedical images on downstream tasks via data augmentation.
blocks.zh: Denoising扩散模型[6]作为一种强大的基因建模方法出现. 在医学成像方面,Pinaya等人。 [12] 证明潜在扩散模型(LDM)能够产生高分辨率的3D脑磁共振扫描,而Khader等人则能够产生高分辨率的脑磁共振扫描。 [9] 通过数据增强,证明了合成生物医学图像对下游任务的作用.

blocks.en: Recent work has addressed the challenge of introducing spatially conditioned generation. Med-DDPM [ 5 ] conditions brain MRI generation using semantic masks, Kebaili et al. [ 8 ] jointly generate multimodal brain MRI and tumour masks, and Zhang et al. [ 16 ] demonstrated controllable pathology generation with LeFusion, which conditions lesion synthesis on spatial location, size, and boundary.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作解决了采用空间条件发电的挑战。 Med-DDPM [5] 条件 脑磁共振生成使用语义口罩, Kebaili 等人. [8]联合生成多模式脑磁共振和肿瘤口罩,张等. [16] 与LeFusion一起演示了可控制病理生成,它把损伤合成作为空间位置、大小和边界的条件。

blocks.en:
ControlNet [ 17 ] provides an architecture for introducing spatial guidance while preserving a pretrained diffusion backbone.
Most similar to our overall pipeline, Kim et al. [ 10 ] introduced 3D-LLDM which first generates tumour segmentation maps which subsequently guide MRI generation using ControlNet.
blocks.zh:
ControlNet [17] 为引入空间引导提供了架构,同时保留了预先训练的传播主干.
最类似于我们整个管道,Kim等人。 [10] 引入了3D-LLDM,它首先生成肿瘤分解图,然后使用ControlNet指导核磁共振生成.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: 3.2 Data and preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据和预处理

blocks.en: We combine the UCSF-PDGM MRI ( n = 494 n=494 ) [ 3 ] and the UPenn-GBM ( n = 611 n=611 ) [ 2 ] datasets, yielding n = 1105 n=1105 subjects with T1, T1Gd, T2, and FLAIR scans and corresponding tumour segmentations. Both cohorts were skull-stripped, and preprocessed using the BrainLes preprocessing package [ 11 ] : negative intensities were clipped, N4 bias-field correction was applied, modalities were co-registered to T1, and volumes were affinely transformed to the SRI24 atlas. Resulting volumes have 1 ​ mm 1\mathrm{mm} isotropic resolution and size 240 × 240 × 155 240\times 240\times 155 .
blocks.zh: 我们结合了UCSF-PDGM MRI(n = 494 n = 494)[3]和UPenn-GBM(n = 611 n = 611)[2]数据集,得出n = 1105 n = 1105 对象与T1,T1Gd,T2,以及FLAIR扫描和相应的肿瘤分化. 两个组群都采用头骨抽取,并使用BrainLes预处理包进行预处理[11]:剪切负强度,采用N4偏侧-场校正,模式共同注册为T1,卷数被亲切转换为SRI24地图集. 结果的卷有 1 mm 1\ mathrm{mm} 的异热带分辨率和大小 240× 240× 155 240\时 240\时 155。

blocks.en: Tumour segmentation maps were transformed into the same space using nearest-neighbour interpolation. Subjects were partitioned at the patient level before axial slice extraction, and all slices were resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 . For MRI synthesis, subjects were randomly assigned to disjoint backbone (75%) and ControlNet (25%) partitions, each being split into 80/10/10 training, validation, and testing sets stratified by cohort. Both VAEs and the Seg-LDM used the unions of the corresponding training, validation and testing subsets. The MRI backbone used only the backbone subsets, while ControlNet used only the ControlNet subsets with the backbone frozen.
blocks.zh: 肿瘤分区图通过最近的邻里插值转换成同一个空间。 轴切片提取前在病人一级进行分片,所有切片被调整为256×256256\时. 在核磁共振合成方面,随机将课题分配到脱节骨干(75%)和ControlNet(25%)分区,每个分区被分成80/10/10训练、验证和测试组按组别分类。 VAEs和Seg-LDM都使用了相应的训练,验证和测试子集的联盟. MRI主干线只使用主干子集,ControlNet只使用主干线被冻结的ControlNet子集.

blocks.en: 3.3 Controllable tumour segmentation map generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 可控制的肿瘤分解图生成

After training, the VAE is frozen and a conditional LDM (Seg-LDM) with a U-Net architecture [ 14 ] learns the distribution of the latent representations of the segmentation maps, conditioned on coarse spatial instruction and global composition. Its centroid 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} and radius r r are 𝝁 = 1 | 𝒮 | ​ ∑ 𝐯 ∈ 𝒮 𝐯 , r = max 𝐯 ∈ 𝒮 ⁡ ‖ 𝐯 − 𝝁 ‖ 2 . \boldsymbol{\mu}=\frac{1}{|\mathcal{S}|}\sum_{\mathbf{v}\in\mathcal{S}}\mathbf{v},\qquad r=\max_{\mathbf{v}\in\mathcal{S}}||\mathbf{v}-\boldsymbol{\mu}||_{2}. (3) These define the binary spatial disk 𝐒 \mathbf{S} , which specifies a coarse spatial region for the tumour, while allowing the model to synthesize the tumour morphology. blocks.en: 3.4 Segmentation-guided MRI generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 分解导磁共振生成

blocks.en: A separately trained VAE encodes the MRI slice 𝐱 ∈ ℝ 256 × 256 \mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{256\times 256} onto the latent representation 𝐳 0 ∈ ℝ 16 × 32 × 32 \mathbf{z}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{16\times 32\times 32} . The MRI-LDM is a U-Net LDM backbone trained on the latent representations of slices across all four modalities. A requested modality m ∈ { T1 , T1Gd , T2 , FLAIR } m\in\{\mathrm{T1},\mathrm{T1Gd},\mathrm{T2},\mathrm{FLAIR}\} is embedded and added to the timestep embedding in the same manner as the Seg-LDM. During training, modality conditioning is randomly removed with p uncond = 0.1 p_{\text{uncond}}=0.1 , allowing for classifier-free guidance. The MRI-LDM is trained using Eq. 2 with conditioning m m .

blocks.en: Once training of the backbone model is complete, the parameters are frozen, and spatial control is introduced via a ControlNet branch. MRI synthesis is guided according to a requested tumour segmentation map 𝐲 \mathbf{y} , which is first projected onto the same spatial resolution as the MRI latents. A trainable copy of the MRI-LDM’s encoder processes 𝐲 , 𝐳 t \mathbf{y},\mathbf{z}_{t} and t t . Multi-scale ControlNet features are then processed by zero-initialised 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutional layers, and additively combined with the backbone skip features. As a result, the ControlNet branch learns how the requested tumour segmentation map should alter the denoising trajectory, producing MRI scans with a matching tumour pathology.
blocks.zh: 一旦主干模型的培训完成,参数就会被冻结,通过ControlNet分支引入空间控制. 核磁共振合成按照所要求的肿瘤分解图y\ mathbf{y}进行引导,该图首先投射到与核磁共振潜质相同的空间分辨率上. MRI-LDM的编码器进程 y, z t\ mathbf{y},\ mathbf{z}_{t} 和 t t 的可列车副本 。 多比例 ControlNet的特性随后通过零初始化的1×1×1\times 1 折叠层处理,并添加与主干跳转特性相结合. 因此,ControlNet分支学习了所请求的肿瘤分解图应如何改变去诺氏轨迹,产生具有匹配肿瘤病理的核磁共振扫描.

blocks.zh: 表2:核磁共振主干线和控制网的FID比较。 每模式分数使用6,918个样本;集合分数使用27,672个样本.

blocks.en:
Image fidelity was evaluated by comparing the same MRI diffusion backbone with the ControlNet branch enabled or disabled. ControlNet used real held-out segmentations.
Table 2 demonstrates that ControlNet reduced Fréchet inception distance (FID) across all four modalities, with the largest improvements for T2 and T1Gd. Pooled FID decreased from 42.59 42.59 to 36.12 36.12 . These results assess MRI synthesis conditioned on real tumour masks; they do not quantify the fidelity of the complete pipeline using Seg-LDM-generated masks.
blocks.zh:
通过将相同的核磁共振扩散主干线与ControlNet已启用或已禁用分支进行比较,对图像的可靠性进行了评估。 控件 净用真持戒分.
表2显示,ControlNet减少了Fréchet在所有四种模式中的启动距离,T2和T1Gd的改进幅度最大。 汇集的FID从42.59 42.59降至36.12 36.12。 这些结果评估了以真正的肿瘤口罩为条件的核磁共振合成;它们没有用Seg-LDM产生的口罩量化整个输油管的忠诚度.

blocks.en: Cross-study FID comparison is limited by differences in datasets, dimensionality, and feature extractors. Akbar et al. [ 1 ] reported FIDs of roughly 16 to 85 across 2D GAN and diffusion models on BraTS, while the recent label-guided 3D-LLDM [ 10 ] reported 28.31 on hepatic MRI. We treat these values as contextual rather than direct baselines, and use the identically evaluated MRI-LDM backbone as our primary comparison.
blocks.zh: 交叉研究FID比较受到数据集、维度和特征提取器差异的限制。 Akbar 等人著. [1] 报告2D GAN的FID大约为16至85,BRATS上的传播模型,而最近标签制导的3D-LLDM[10] 报告了28.31 肝核磁共振. 我们将这些数值作为背景而不是直接基线,并使用同样评估的核磁共振-LDM主干线作为我们的主要比较。

blocks.en: Table 3: Mean reader quality ratings (1–10) across MRI modalities and image groups.
blocks.zh: 表3:所有磁共振模式和图像组的平均读者质量评级(1至10)。

blocks.en: Four readers each rated 36 segmentation–MRI pairs on a 1–10 scale from three groups: real segmentation with real MRI, real segmentation with synthetic MRI (ControlNet), and fully synthetic segmentation–MRI pairs. Mean ratings were 6.60, 6.83, and 6.77 for the real, ControlNet-generated, and fully synthetic groups, respectively. These descriptive results provide an exploratory assessment of perceived quality; the small reader panel and limited image sample do not establish equivalence between real and synthetic images.
blocks.zh: 4个阅读器按1-10的尺度对36个区段-MRI配对,分别是:真区段与真核磁共振,真区段与合成核磁共振(ControlNet),全合成区段-MRI配对. 真实的、ControlNet生成的和完全合成的团体的平均收视率分别为6.60、6.83和6.77。 这些描述性结果提供了对所感知质量的探索性评估;小的阅读面板和有限的图像样本不能确定真实图像和合成图像的等效性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced a two-stage conditional latent diffusion framework for controllable glioblastoma brain MRI synthesis. The conditional Seg-LDM enables explicit control over the spatial location, extent, and composition of brain tumour, which can be supplied to a ControlNet architecture that generates a corresponding multi-modal 2D brain MRI slice consistent with the requested pathology. The promise of this approach is verified by qualitative analysis of the synthetic images, with expert evaluation providing complementary assessment of image realism. Future work will extend this framework into native volumetric generation.
All the code used in this work is available at: https://github.com/SteveG365/GBM-Diff .
blocks.zh:
我们引入了两阶段的有条件潜在扩散框架,用于可控制的胶原脑磁共振合成。 有条件的Seg-LDM能够对大脑肿瘤的空间位置,范围,组成进行明确的控制,这可以提供给一个ControlNet架构,生成一个符合所请求的病理的对应多模式2D脑磁共振切片. 通过对合成图像的定性分析,对这种方法的希望进行了核实,专家评价对图像现实性提供了补充评估。 今后的工作将把这一框架扩大到本土体积发电。
本作品使用的所有代码均可在https://github.com/SteveG365/GBM-Diff上查阅.

blocks.en: 6 Compliance with Ethical Standards
blocks.zh: 6 遵守道德标准

blocks.en: The imaging data used in this study were obtained from publicly available, de-identified datasets. The expert reader study involved voluntary assessment of de-identified and synthetic images. In accordance with institutional requirements, formal ethical approval and waiver were not required.
blocks.zh: 本研究所用的成像数据是从公开的、已解析的数据集中获得的。 专家读者研究涉及对未识别和合成图像的自愿评估。 根据机构要求,不需要正式的道德批准和放弃。
